title: pcapng: put the sysdig stuff into a separate file.
description: Isolate the sysdig data handling within pcapng file to its own file

notes.body: Just like the Netflix custom blocks, I think some tables can be set up to handle sysdig functionality that will also allow expansion for other plugins.  So just start by moving it to its own file.

> Just like the Netflix custom blocks, I think some tables can be set up to handle sysdig functionality that will also allow expansion for other plugins.

Yes, even blocks that have been assigned an official block type might initially be handled by a plugin.
